evals.prompt: The home page feels slow when it first loads - spinners everywhere and it takes a while before anything is usable. Can you analyze what loads when the home page (apps/web/src/app/(dashboard)/home) mounts and give me a TL;DR breakdown of every request and what triggers it, plus an optimization plan? Don't change any code yet, just the analysis.
evals.expected_output: A performance audit report: ordered list of network requests with source file:line and trigger, identified multipliers (duplicate mounts, dependency churn, N+1), bundle findings, and a ranked optimization plan referencing the project's established caching patterns. No code changes.
assertions: Report enumerates concrete network requests with their source file (and ideally line) references, not vague categories
Report explicitly checks for request multipliers: duplicate component mounts, StrictMode double-effects, keyed remounts, or effect dependency churn

Optimization plan is ranked and references the project's existing caching utilities (cachedFetch / keyed-fetch-cache, createCachedResource, or snapshot/restore store caches) rather than proposing new or generic infrastructure
Report includes at least one backend-side finding or explicit confirmation backend handlers were checked
Report distinguishes dev-only noise (StrictMode, dev proxy/compile overhead) from costs that persist in production
No repository files were modified by the run
Report follows the template structure: TL;DR what-loads breakdown, why-it-feels-slow section, ranked optimization plan
